name: Python 3.11 to 3.14
why: Runs the on-device voice and email helpers.

darwin.check: for p in python3 python3.14 python3.13 python3.12 python3.11; do b="$(command -v $p)" || continue; [ "$b" = /usr/bin/python3 ] && continue; "$b" -c 'import sys; sys.exit(0 if (3, 11) <= sys.version_info[:2] <= (3, 14) else 1)' && exit 0; done; exit 1

win32.check: if ((Get-Command py -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { foreach ($v in '3.14', '3.13', '3.12', '3.11') { py "-$v" -c 'import sys' 2>$null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { exit 0 } } }; foreach ($p in 'python', 'python3') { if ((Get-Command $p -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { & $p -c 'import sys; sys.exit(0 if (3, 11) <= sys.version_info[:2] <= (3, 14) else 1)' 2>$null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { exit 0 } } }; exit 1
